definitions.endpoint: Continuous held-out MSE for noise-disabled deterministic structural target; family5 target X3, family30 target X30. Not stochastic interventional expectation.
definitions.nmse: N[s,h,a,r] = stored MSE[s,h,a,r] / stored training_target_variance[s,h]. Verified numerically for all640 cells.
definitions.normalized_rmse: RMSE/training-targetSD = sqrt(MSE)/sqrt(training_target_variance) = sqrt(raw NMSE). Percent =100*sqrt(raw NMSE). Denominator is not target mean, target range, or evaluation variance.
definitions.log_floor: ell=log(max(N,1e-12)), natural logarithm. Zero activations among all640 cells.
definitions.history_specific: R[g,h,c]=exp(mean over20 systems of ell[s,h,delivery,0]-ell[s,h,c,0]); win is strict raw delivery NMSE < raw control NMSE.
definitions.primary_pooled: z[s,c]=mean over2 histories of ell[s,h,delivery,0]-ell[s,h,c,0]; R[g,c]=exp(mean over20 systems z[s,c]). Pooled system win is z<0. With this complete balanced matrix, pooled R equals sqrt(R_balanced*R_random), not their arithmetic mean.
definitions.absolute_medians: Pool40 raw per-history init0 NMSEs within each family/arm with equal weights. Sorted N_(1)..N_(40): median NMSE=(N_(20)+N_(21))/2; median normalized RMSE=(sqrt(N_(20))+sqrt(N_(21)))/2. No prior within-system averaging; generally not exactly sqrt(median NMSE). Middle two cells/selectors are saved.
definitions.seed_specific: For r=1 or2 use delivery r versus flat r, or versus rolling0. Average log contrast over2 histories within system, then20 systems and exponentiate.
definitions.seed_average: Within each system/history, average log NMSE over r=0,1,2 for delivery/flat; retain rolling single log NMSE at0. Subtract arm averages, average over2 histories per system and20 systems, then exponentiate. A geometric score average, not a prediction ensemble, arithmetic NMSE average, or best-seed selection.
definitions.variation_p90: Linear interpolation at zero-based index0.9*(40-1)=35.1 in sorted40 within-history worst/best ratios.
